items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: I have great love for her son... I know the last name was the Carlson family. They were very, she was a nice-looking lady, very cultured and polished and very businesslike.

ctx.x: It's interesting that the woman who owned JBW would hire you to do a remote, but wouldn't let you be in the studio. But it was okay if you were someplace else.

Well, that was the law at the time, because, you know, the Carlson family were very beautiful people. I have great love for her son. I think his name was Richard Carlson, if you remember. Not Richard, it was something else. But anyhow, I know the last name was the Carlson family. They were very, she was a nice-looking lady, very cultured and polished and very businesslike. Well, that's the way I approached her, and that's the way she dealt with me. But you've got to remember, we're dealing with 1948, 49, and 50,…
Getting back to, I'm saying laws and things, but you had white kids coming down to this black lounge. Black, right, right. And listening to, were there any problems there? No problem.
